title: CSV formatter next to the report module
approach: Add a pure function that turns the weekly rows into CSV text, and a download handler that names the file with today's date.
pros: Reuses weeklyRows in src/report/weekly.js, already covered by tests
cons: The number of weeks stays an open question
risks: Revenue rounding must match the page (formatMoney in src/report/format.js)

repoChanges.summary: Add the CSV formatter and the download handler.
